04 · Fabrication extras

Search and select a country or region above, then choose its outline. Islands remain separate pieces.

Every generated Terrain Medal permanently includes the governed provenance mark and © 2026 VYNDI RIDE STORIES on the underside.

Optional front logo uses the official artwork. Move, resize and rotate it within the selected map.

Printable place labels
Selected places
Load a map to choose places.

Major only is the governed print default. Selected only prints only the checked locations. All is retained for diagnostic use and remains collision-limited.

Printable map layers & 3MF colors

Fabrication extras are applied only to generated STL/3MF. OpenTopography keys are sent only with the requested DEM call and are not stored. Personal/commercial use must follow OpenTopography API terms; commercial software integration may require an Enterprise API key.

READY FOR CONFIGURATION

The preview uses representative relief until an authoritative DEM mesh is generated.

PRINT MODEL

Not generated. Terrain, GPX, major roads, governed place labels and event text will be converted into physical relief.
